BEGIN;

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS course_level_slug_update_unique_trigger ON course_level;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS enforce_course_level_slug_update_unique();
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS track_level_slug_unique_trigger ON track_level;
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS enforce_track_level_slug_unique();

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM course_level
        GROUP BY slug
        HAVING count(*) > 1
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'cannot restore global course_level slug uniqueness while duplicate slugs exist';
    END IF;
END;
$$;

ALTER TABLE course_level
    ADD CONSTRAINT course_level_slug_key UNIQUE (slug);

COMMIT;
